_comment: Allowlist for check-crm-scope.mjs. Each entry is a person-scoped CRM mutation that intentionally does NOT use requirePersonInScope, with the reason it is safe. The count may only SHRINK — a new unguarded mutation must be fixed, not added here without review. See scripts/check-crm-scope.mjs.

allow.reason: Intentionally cross-broker: claiming an unowned pond lead. Authorization is pond membership (crm_pond_members) + an optimistic pond_id lock, NOT current ownership — requirePersonInScope would defeat the feature (you claim a lead you do not yet own).

Global pipeline config, not a per-person IDOR: bulk-reassigns crm_people by stage KEY (.eq('stage', key)), never by a caller-supplied person id. Whether stage-config management should be superuser-only is a separate authorization-policy question tracked for Matt, not a contact-scoping bug this gate governs.
